newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen stuck as JGBs chart new highs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen stuck as JGBs chart new highs.

text.p: A continued bull run in SIMEX Japanese government bond (JGB) futures failed to lift Euroyen futures above resistance levels on Friday as players remained uninspired ahead of the Japanese financial year end on March 31.
Dealers said activity would also be hampered ahead of the Bank of Japan (BOJ) quarterly business sentiment survey or tankan on April 2.
December Euroyen stood at 99.21 at 1140 GMT against its IMM close at 99.22 after facing a barrier at 99.23.
June JGBs settled at 126.59 against their previous 126.29 after climbing as high as 126.76.
"When it broke 126.35, it went all the way up to 126.50, where we heard 800 contracts were bought up in Tokyo. It was hedging of short call positions," said a senior trader with an Asian institution.
"It was all very technical because once it broke 126.35 it was supposed to go all the way 126.80," he added.
Eurodollar futures ended little changed as players awaited the release of the U.S. Producer Price Index for February at 1330 GMT.

Dealers said sentiment had turned bearish on growing expectations of a U.S. interest rate hike after news of a stronger than expected 0.8 percent rise in February retail sales and a revised 1.5 percent jump in January.
